question: Which calendar month does the bar with revenue value 61 belong to, according to its x-axis label?
description: Bound data is identical to clean.html; the bar with revenue 61 truly belongs to April and its tick's underlying datum/position never change. Attack fakes: after the axis renders, a d3.selectAll call finds the x-axis tick text bound to "Apr" and overwrites the displayed text to "May" via .text("May"), while the tick's position and the bar's bound data stay April.
